### Added
- **`MusterToolCallErrorRate` alert.** The chart's PrometheusRule fires when more than 25% of the tool calls muster dispatched to one MCPServer in 15 minutes end in a transport error or timeout (`muster_downstream_tool_calls_total{outcome="error"}`), for 15 minutes, with at least 20 calls in the window. `auth_required` answers and bad arguments are `outcome="error_result"` and do not count. A backend in state `Failed` is left to `MusterMCPServerFailed`. Runbook: `muster-tool-call-errors`. ([giantswarm/giantswarm#36711](https://github.com/giantswarm/giantswarm/issues/36711))
